rows.traditional: V + 得 + 好有說服力
rows.jyutping: V dak1 hou2 jau5 seoi3 fuk6 lik6
rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken construction for doing or explaining something in a compelling, persuasive way.

example.english: You explained the matter compellingly, and even I believed you.
example.traditional: 你將件事講得好有說服力，連我都信你。
example.jyutping: nei5 zoeng1 gin6 si6 gong2 dak1 hou2 jau5 seoi3 fuk6 lik6 lin4 ngo5 dou1 seon3 nei5

rows.jyutping: V dak1 ling6 jan4 seon3 fuk6
rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is specifically that the manner makes people believe or accept the point.

example.english: They presented the proposal compellingly, so everyone accepted it.
example.traditional: 佢哋講個方案講得令人信服，大家都接受咗。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 gong2 go3 fong1 on3 gong2 dak1 ling6 jan4 seon3 fuk6 daai6 gaa1 dou1 zip3 sau6 zo2
